text:
maria: Quick proposal — phased "wind-down" of several legacy admin entitlements starting next month. Goal: remove 15–25 stale org/admin bindings without breaking pipelines. Planning a canary-first approach + audit log validation. link: https://redwood/internal/SEC-4521 :eyes:
ken: Sounds good. Suggest starting with non-human principals (svc accounts) as the first canary wave, then small human groups. Also want a pre/post KMS grant snapshot for each wave.
sam: I can own the test plan. What smoke tests do we need for every wave?
maria: Nice — test plan outline 
- inventory + owner reachout
- snapshot KMS grants and IAM bindings
- remove entitlements for wave
- run smoke tests for 2h (jobs + deploys)
- collect audit logs and check for unexpected denies
- rollback if any production failures > 1% error increase

I'll paste the snapshot commands we want to standardize: 
maria: ```# kms/iam snapshot (example)
gcloud kms keys list --location=global --project=redwood-prod 
python tools/kms_snapshot.py --project redwood-prod --out=/tmp/kms-snap-wave1.json
rbacctl export --scope org --out /tmp/iam-snap-wave1.json
```
lisa: I'll be on-call for the first two waves and can run the rollback playbook if needed. Please tag me when you schedule. :+1:
ken: For rollback we should codify an emergency re-grant group and a short SLA — 2 hours to re-add and validate. Also add a runbook step to check KMS key policy vs. IAM binding (we had a drift earlier).
sam: For smoke tests I'll include: CI pipeline runs for 3 representative services, nightly job run, and a quick telemetry check (error rates, auth denies). I'll add automated assertions to the test harness so we get fast feedback.
sec-bot: Reminder: After each wave, trigger access-certification job and tag PR with compliance evidence.
maria: Decision: Wave 0 (canary) = 3 svc accounts + 1 infra human; Wave 1 = 10% humans in one business unit; Wave 2 = 30% roll; full sweep after successful audits. Schedule: start Mon May 11 (wave0), then weekly waves.
lisa: FYI add me to the KMS owners list for quick approvals during rollback.
ken: I'll take snapshots this week and share diffs in the ticket. Also will add a short script to diff key grants: `tools/kms_diff.py before.json after.json`.
sam: I'll draft the test harness and post a runbook snippet in the ticket.
maria: Action items: Sam -> test plan + harness; Ken -> snapshots + diff script; Lisa -> rollback playbook + on-call; Maria -> owner outreach + ticket SEC-4521. We'll reconvene next Wednesday for wave0 signoff. :calendar: 
lisa: :thumbsup: 
ken: ack
sam: on it
sec-bot: Audit: evidence collection scheduled for 48h after each removal. Ensure logs ship to longterm-retention.
maria: Thanks all — I'll open the canary PR and tag the owners. If anyone spots a missing critical binding in the snapshots, ping me immediately.
